title: 이 한 곡만 더
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Ballad. A clean, fingerpicked acoustic guitar plays a steady eighth-note pattern. A male tenor vocal performs with a breathy, intimate delivery in the verses, transitioning to a powerful, belted chest voice in the chorus. A sub-heavy kick drum and subtle shaker provide a rhythmic pulse. A grand piano enters with sustained chords and melodic fills. The arrangement builds with a lush string section providing legato pads and a melodic bass guitar that follows the chord roots with occasional melodic passing tones. Key of E Major. Tempo is 72 BPM. 4/4 time signature. High-fidelity production with polished vocal compression and hall reverb.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[fingerpicked acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals]
벗으면 뒷자리 노을이 쏟아져
이어폰 한쪽을 네가 내밀었어
아무 말 없이 음악이 흘러가
손등에 닿은 햇살 네 건지 내 건지

[Pre-Chorus]
[piano enters, subtle kick drum and shaker]
이 노래가 끝나면 정류장이 올 텐데
벨을 눌러야 해 근데 손이 안 가

[Chorus]
[full strings enter, belted vocals]
이 한 곡만 더 이 한 정거장만 더
노을이 지기 전에 이 순간을
